meta.title: About
meta.description: Replace with a sentence about who runs the business and what it stands for.

hero.title: About us
hero.subtitle: One paragraph. Who you are, how long you have been doing this, and where you are based.

story.title: How we got here
story.body: Two or three paragraphs of real history. When the business started, what it started doing, what changed. Specific beats impressive: a founding year and a first customer are worth more than a page of mission statement.

honest.title: We say no
honest.body: If the work is not a good fit we say so rather than taking it and doing it badly.

direct.title: We answer
direct.body: Messages get a reply the same working day, including the awkward ones.

finish.title: We finish
finish.body: A job is done when it works in your hands, not when we have run out of hours.

cta.title: Want to talk?
cta.body: The first conversation costs nothing and usually settles whether it is worth having a second.
